implementation.source: Actual Patient/Admission, all charges including reversed/unknown states, complete order/item/execution/eMAR roots. Billing Gate before current Patient/Admission and current full members; 8192 roots and whole8MiB all-or-refuse. Explicit independent human source review/publication and immutable six-hash projection proof.
implementation.amount_and_quantity: Existing recorded amount decimal strings are preserved. Existing Float driver value and same-query MySQL DOUBLE/binary witnesses are recorded separately; neither recovers the exact originally entered decimal. No rounding to claim equivalence, assumed currency, historical price or invented per-line execution allocation.
implementation.model_output: Dedicated System and Task Prompt; closed <=128 partial literal questions with exact Unicode-codepoint quotes. BOM/CRLF/emoji/combining characters retained. Empty output does not prove correctness, completeness, missing charges, duplicate charges or payment eligibility.
implementation.task_storage: Three raw Task JSON TEXT bodies each<=65535 bytes plus separate whole8MiB Source/Result Artifact. Six SHA bindings, exact Run identity/lease and specific terminal usage/accept AuditPK; all22 terminal Run fields read back atomically. Individual nullable paid usage retained; known queued zero is distinct from unknown interrupted usage.
implementation.privacy_and_runtime: Current actor/token/source/provider/config/Prompt/quota checks before and after a single Chat/Responses MockTransport call; no SQL connection held over model await. Public technical projection minimizes identifiers but is not an anonymity guarantee. Actual legacy billing writers serialize at the common Billing Gate.
implementation.frontend: Dedicated Source/Input/Assistant/Findings, sticky native Parent and separately validated fullRun plus sameRun Super trace. Accepted Source-filter scope and residual uniqueDomain/selected_sources anchors cannot downgrade to a generic result when tags disappear. Role/session/scope/close/KeepAlive and late results clear private material.
implementation.legacy_boundary: Native-only listing is opt-in and used by dedicated new UI; true historical generic69 entries remain readable under existing authorization. Native artifacts/markers are classified strictly, including explicit null markers. This does not retroactively turn old clipped feedback or legacy generic output into a native verified result.
implementation.financial_boundary: No new charge, price/quantity edit, refund, payment, settlement or automatic billing action. Settled/refunded and deposit aggregates are recorded states rather than actual cash-flow evidence.
